Dungeons Deep Update - Chapter I
notes.notes:
This patch paves the road for a three chapter main update, that could even be considered as an expansion of sorts. The first Chapter brings to us the Webveil Hollow instance, along lots of riches and some new materials and items. Some important notes towards those are the Ember Wand that shoots fireballs, three drafts that have various functions, one bringing home decorations for example, the other two enabling a foodstuff or a material. The foodstuff being called Cozonak, with a big replenish pool and the material is Noble Fabric that will be linked to future utilities in-game. This update has a divination action (

key ) tweak and two new achievements regarding the instance, along other fixes and tweaks. To be noted that Webveil Hollow is reeking with broodkins and their relatives but holds great treasures as the ones in the beginning of this post. On an ending note, please consider reviewing the game and letting me know more of your insights on the project's discord server. Also, if there are missing links in-game or bugs, I'll try to cover them ASAP. Enjoy!

notes.notes:
Hey there!

This update brings:

* Few more bug-fixes;
* A revamp to equipped gear pieces giving stats, meaning:
Because of a framework's limitations that at a given time started duping equipped item's stats, I've decided to remove the named stats and upon equipping a gear item - such as boots, that were giving +5 STA - from now on the player will receive a Equipment Power point or more for each gear piece active on the character; Because the duping bug is still there and I don't want to allow possible inbalances in the gameplay, at a given time the Equipment Power will reach a capped 100 value.
- This 100 EP value is available to be converted to VIT/STA/WIS stats at the anvil.

Soon will come back with another batch of bug-fixes and might rest for a couple of days because as you can see all I do is to come with lots of updates for bugs I make solving bugs I make.

In an ending note, earlier today I've capped around 35 FPS in the editor. So somewhat progression regarding optimization was made, and the problem causing this was confirmed.

Take care and enjoy!

Another day, another update. <3

There are yet some small bugs that wear off by double tapping the ESC key such as the cursor/camera misbehavior sometimes when exiting UI elements, and the more persistent ones that refresh after a cold save & load. I do try to fix them in time but sometimes what a dev wants to do is tackled by what a dev can do. Some things will be fixed later due some used frameworks limiations that I'm trying to overcome.

Until then, if you find anything that's gamebreaking / persistent and I haven't managed to fix yet, please report either on Steam Discussions / Discord group as a reminder, or something I haven't encountered yet.

If the game starts misbehaving with this new Winter Update that you haven't yet installed, please do a fresh save. As an ending note, if you see the game is indeed weird, maybe I've messed something up with an update and please check for a new update asap. Hopefully I won't need to update the game again today and just prepare for the upcoming week.

Take care!

Sincerely,
Musbrich.

notes.title: Community Announcement #2 - Launch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051745/b04a67207dc81060432075b26636a94c46a1e7e8.png[/img]
Greetings everyone,

First and foremost, thank you everyone that messaged me in a way or another, I'll start filtering messages and reply accordingly.

Secondly, I'll admit it from start that the game is missing some key aspects of what I wanted to provide on launch, such as the Co-Op - it's just postponed - and dungeons or other small but needed stuff. There yet might be some bugs, but to my apology please understand that I'm overwhelmed by everything happening in my schedule and exhaustion is already a state of being. I've decided to launch the game as it is so far because otherwise tinkering on it would never finish.

My plans remain unshaken, I'll make way towards a dungeon system, some other elements such as NPC's and foes and the so much praised Co-Op that is playable to an extent will begin to be taken in consideration again. If the community decides that it's of their will to try it out, I could rebuild the Co-Op to a state somewhere to singleplayer fidelity.

I must tell that it is indeed a lack of attention that I've not set an welcoming discount for this launch, but trust me there will be plenty of them in the time to come.

This will be my main choice of announcements such as this one and explaining further updates, fixes and so on, while the social media will still get attention as a single developer it can be time-killing to keep up with everything.

For those that really want to know, I'll try to form a local team from my area at some point, but internationals are not excluded, just that I will leave everything some time to settle in.

Dear Curators, thank you for asking for my permission to curate the game, you will receive a key shortly. The fact that there's an interest for Ravensthorn is heart-warming for me and I do hope you'll understand what is this project about.

And in a final note, stay tuned in as there will be some small updates to give this dish some more flavor.

Cheers to everyone!

Truly,
Musbrich.

notes.title: Demo Announcement - Final
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051745/e010170acf583167d571b4319f21ea3b475710b8.png[/img]
Hey there!

So it is happening.. this is my final post regarding Ravensthorn Demo. Somewhere this weekend or next week I'll stop updating it, preparing for the late 2024 launch. Today's update will bring some more content and contour to the game such as a character stats management, some gear and the prototyping of Alchemy along various bug-fixes and QoL changes.

This Demo & Steam Next Fest grind was one of a kind, with good and bad some days were indeed tough lessons for me. Even though that the game didn't perform as I was hoping regarding wishlists and such, I've decided to keep going forward.

At launch I'll do my best to deliver a 100% fidelity inbetween singleplayer and co-op, such thing that will enter in development along this weekend, but it might not happen to have such fidelity. We never know what's ahead of us.

I do somehow expect to have a rough launch, but will try to not postpone it. And with those final words, I'd like to thank you all, for your smallest like or longest playthrough, you've made some of my days brighter. See you again soon!

Sincerely,
Musbrich.

notes.title: Community Announcement #1
Community Bug-Report Hotfixing #5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051745/e010170acf583167d571b4319f21ea3b475710b8.png[/img]
Hey there! It has been a while since my last post here. IRL got too crowded too soon as I've changed workplaces and with the utter need to see as much as possible done in Ravensthorn, yesterday I've concluded that's better to rest as my brain couldn't do the work anymore. Good news is that even there's a time for work and a time for rest, I've managed to check all what's up on my mind for a while, and this beautiful rainy Sunday night I can get to sleep earlier.

Regarding this..
I've managed to fix the first reported bug on Steam, that about a hidden achievement that was not working. Now it is, along two more from which one is hidden and I won't spoil it for you. So thank you to the one whom pointed it out, otherwise I would'nt have had the motivation to see that achievement done too soon honestly, now it stands as a great addition to Ravensthorn Demo.

After a tedious process, mostly because I block myself for days on some minor mistakes, and with the help of two great individuals, I've managed to connect along three other on a server I was hosting on my personal PC. This meaning the Co-Op is on our reach as it needs some more polishing, such as character customisation being visible for everyone on the server, not the individual player; pick-up utility; stats management and some more, yet nothing impossible just time demanding.

Also I've decided to postpone the launch from Q4 2024 just to get some more days of work for a better polish and get a proper momentum, in hopes that more will join the community after Steam's Next Fest this October. Really considering to give back to the community, I'll let you know of one thing that's on my mind for the close-future after another polisihing campaign happens is in the means of those consacrated RPG themed [i]dungeons[/i], that will come in various sizes and shapes with time. As told before, after a polish or even two, some more content for crafting and building and when I'll have the Co-Op done in proper terms, my aim will move towards having one dungeon hopefully ready for the launch or close after. But as always, my problem is not how to do it or what will it take for, but time became slowly the most valuable asset that comes to my hands.

As always, there have been multiple hotfixes or small polishes, sometimes too many and too small to keep track outside my notebook, and still recommend to report bugs or whatever touches a nerve either on Steam Community or on Discord so I can see what can be done in good time.

Even if all my promises will not be there by launch and the future community might ravage Ravensthorn, I'll do my best to finish them step by step and in an ending word, I must admit that barely now things start to get a shape - even in my mind - of what will it be.

Yours sincerely,
Musbrich.

notes.title: Community Bug-Report Hotfixing #4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051745/e010170acf583167d571b4319f21ea3b475710b8.png[/img]
Greetings!

I've yet come up with another update post, though there have been countless updates to the Demo past week and such. This post marks the fourth [i]big[/i] update that needs a little something announced.

First and foremost, I might stop updating the Demo content-wise, and will come back to it with various bug-fixes if - of course - the community will report them either here on Steam, or on Ravensthorn Discord ( https://discord.gg/4YmS2ftX3u ) in the designated channel. Stopping updating the Demo doesn't mean that my work here is done, and as you all that tried it out could see there are missing crafts, foodstuff and the list could go on and on, it just means that I'll focus on the main branch of the game, that as how I want will most probably hit Steam somewhere later this year if all goes well.
To end this paragraph, I'll remember those interested in my work that most probably the save files will be shared among the Demo / Open Beta release once it hits the platform, and my biggest wish is that when I'll launch it there should be a co-op option for those that want to make some memories in this fairytale setting.

Regarding this last content update, I've added some [i]sauce[/i] to that nightfall sound that scares even me at times, some more content regarding crafting that is discontinued, lots of QoL resolves and some bug fixing such as in the means of that invisible inventory upon load. Although that the update landed on Steam last night, and this post is written just now I must confess that time was not on my side and every new change or update wasn't fully tested yet, so indeed there might be some more bug-fixing updates.
Also, because the stairs from Castle Ravensthorn are indeed steep there was added a [i]magic[/i] item that will help you on this matter.

If other questions have risen and were not addressed properly or at all, or if some bugs have indeed been forgotten please either come on Discord or here on Steam at Ravensthorn's community and lets have a dialogue. I might've pointed to most important stuff that has happened, but there's always place to improve.


Faithfully,
Musbrich.

notes.title: Community Bug-Report Hotfixing #3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051745/25530a05a8182ba6b8ac8b85955fb6a7d6c3c2da.png[/img]
Hey there!

If some were paying attention, the Demo got three updates since yesterday, with small and various hotfixes, some more polishing and such. I will still be testing the live branch, but if you casually find some more bugs please let me know via Discord ( https://discord.gg/4YmS2ftX3u ) .

Some informations that I feel most should know, there are some used assets that might have a bug or two of their own, that come out from my power of development yet, such as the Inventory one that on load-game makes all of your inventory/equipped tools to become invisible, a quick in-game fix from your side is to either unequip a tool or just pick-up closest forageable item.
Another bug I've encountered is the walking on spot when < C > key is pressed, something I'll address later today most probably. Other bug I've yet to understand are the Tooltips getting blocked on UI after you harvest a forageable or cut down a tree / mine a boulder, but the in-game fix for this is to just hover your crosshair on the same object as your stuck tooltip has.

For now those three ringed in my head and if some are still there, feel free to let me know, or once I'll see them again will do my best to fix it asap. Although they are some casual bugs, they're not game-breaking, meaning your progress / saves won't get stuck or needing a restart of the Demo.

One little hint I want to let you know is that, most possibly, your saved game data will be actually available in-game on the full release, but if you'd like to start fresh for whatever reson go to the main menu's options, there's a delete-save button.

I'd do enjoy some more activity on the Discord honestly, as it feels very empty and some motivation is always most welcomed.

PS. You can now swim! But might fall off the world edge aswell hahaha
PSS. You can now sprint ( SHIFT ), and do some nice super-hero landings xD
